integrity: The two included independent finite checkers corroborate widths 4..13 and cyclic-tiling widths 4..18. The infinite theorem has an explicit combinatorial proof.
scientific_limitations: The sharp flip-length threshold is proved for labelled Möbius ladders with n>=4, with one alternating simple cycle per move. Earlier four-cycle Lucas-cube structure and known perfect-matching counts are not claimed as new. The full texts of some historical papers were inaccessible; independent validation is not performed.
title: The sharp alternating-cycle flip threshold for Möbius-ladder perfect matchings
